projectDescription: A SocialTech platform for builders that turns goals, daily progress logs, and execution history into a public proof-of-work trajectory.
keyFeatures: ARC System — structured project and goal management with milestones and progression history
Trace Logging — daily proof-of-work updates with text, images, videos, and metrics
Trajectory Dashboard — visual timeline of consistency, momentum, and ARC growth
Recommendation Feed — intelligent algorithm (65% verified builders, 35% organic discovery) scoring by engagement, creator quality, freshness, retention, and virality
Live Streaming — real-time video broadcasts with live chat and viewer tips
Creator Monetization — support tips and video RPM ($0.40/1,000 views) with 80% net revenue share
Subscription Plans — Standard ($2.50/mo), Medium ($6.00/mo), Pro ($10.00/mo) with progressive feature unlocks
Elite Recruiter Access — monthly ($40) and annual ($384) plans to search certified builder profiles
Mobile Money Payouts — Airtel Money, Orange Money, M-Pesa, Afrimoney withdrawal support
Professional Pages — dedicated business/recruiter page for Pro accounts
Messaging & Notifications — real-time direct messages and push notifications
PWA Support — installable progressive web app with offline capabilities
Internationalization — French and English language support
publicApiSurface: POST /api/app/interaction/track — record a user interaction (view, like, share, comment, bookmark, follow)
POST /api/app/feed/impression — record a creator feed impression with position and recommendation score
POST /api/app/content-metrics/update — update engagement metrics for a content item
POST /api/kpay/checkout — initiate a subscription or support payment via KPay
GET /api/creator-revenue/:userId — fetch a creator's earnings summary
GET /api/monetization/overview — creator wallet summary, payout method, and recent history
POST /api/monetization/payout-settings — save or update Mobile Money withdrawal account
GET /api/app/discover/users — fetch ranked discovery feed using the XERA1 v2 composite recommendation algorithm
